subject: Decision Making
subcategory: Famous Decisions That Changed the World
title: De Klerk Ends Apartheid
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: De Klerk Ends Apartheid.

hook.text: In 1990, President F.W. de Klerk unbanned the ANC and freed Mandela.

buildup.text: Apartheid faced global sanctions, internal resistance, and economic collapse.

discovery.text: De Klerk calculated that negotiating now would preserve more for the white minority than being forced to surrender.

twist.text: Many within his own party called him a traitor. He sacrificed political survival for national survival.

climax.text: De Klerk chose the least bad option. When all paths lead to loss, the best decision minimizes total damage.

punchline.text: Negotiate now or lose everything later. He chose the smaller loss.

quiz.question: Why did de Klerk choose to end apartheid?
options: He was forced by the military
Negotiating now preserved more than being forced to surrender later
